title: Apple AirPods 5
descriptionText: Advanced Active Noise Cancellation (ANC) Open-Ear Design for Comfortable Everyday Listening Up to 50% More External Noise Reduction Than Previous Generation Improved Transparency Mode New Multiport Acoustic Architecture Next-Generation Adaptive EQ for Richer Sound Personalized Spatial Audio Experience Up to 5 Hours of Listening with ANC Enabled USB-C Charging Case Hands-Free Siri with Apple Intelligence Integration Head Gesture Controls for Siri Interactions Comfortable Fit Designed for Different Ear Shapes IP57 Dust & Water Resistance Apple AirPods 5 Advanced Active Noise Cancellation The Apple AirPods 5 feature improved Active Noise Cancellation designed to reduce unwanted background noise while maintaining the comfort of an open-ear design. Apple claims up to 50% more external noise reduction compared with the previous generation, allowing you to enjoy music, podcasts, and calls with fewer distractions. Comfortable Open-Ear Design Designed without silicone ear tips, the AirPods 5 offer a comfortable and lightweight open-ear listening experience. Their improved design is intended to accommodate different ear shapes, making them suitable for everyday use. Enhanced Sound with Multiport Acoustic Architecture The AirPods 5 feature a new multiport acoustic architecture designed to deliver richer, clearer, and more detailed audio for music, movies, podcasts, and everyday entertainment. Next-Generation Adaptive EQ Next-generation Adaptive EQ automatically adjusts the sound to help provide a more consistent listening experience across different ear shapes and listening conditions. Personalized Spatial Audio Enjoy a more immersive listening experience with Personalized Spatial Audio, designed to create a spacious and engaging sound experience for compatible music, movies, and entertainment. Improved Transparency Mode Transparency Mode allows you to hear surrounding sounds and conversations more naturally without removing your earbuds, making it convenient for travelling, commuting, and everyday activities. Up to 5 Hours of Listening Time The Apple AirPods 5 provide up to 5 hours of listening with Active Noise Cancellation enabled, offering dependable battery performance for music, calls, and entertainment. Convenient USB-C Charging Case The included USB-C charging case provides convenient wired charging and allows you to recharge your earbuds when needed. Its compact design makes it easy to carry your AirPods throughout the day. Hands-Free Siri with Apple Intelligence When paired with a compatible Apple Intelligence-enabled iPhone, the AirPods 5 support hands-free Siri interactions, allowing you to access supported information and perform everyday tasks using voice commands. Smart Head Gesture Controls The AirPods 5 support convenient head gesture interactions with Siri. Nod your head to indicate “yes” or shake your head to indicate “no” for supported interactions without using your hands. IP57 Dust & Water Resistance With IP57 dust and water resistance, the AirPods 5 provide additional protection against dust and temporary water immersion under specified test conditions, making them suitable for everyday activities. Seamless Apple Ecosystem Experience Designed for convenient integration with compatible Apple devices, the AirPods 5 combine wireless audio, intelligent features, immersive sound, and everyday convenience.

Stylish Colour Options The Sony WH-CH530 is available in six attractive colours: Black, White, Pink, Coral, Mint, and Cobalt, allowing you to choose a style that matches your preference. Ideal for Everyday Entertainment Combining wireless connectivity, lightweight comfort, long battery life, and clear calling features, the Sony WH-CH530 is a practical choice for music, online classes, work, travel, and daily entertainment.

title: Apple iPhone Duo 1TB
descriptionText: First foldable iPhone from Apple Large 7.6-inch Super Retina XDR display 48MP Dual Fusion camera system Powerful A20 Pro chip with AI Dual-battery all-day power Premium titanium foldable design Pre Order Now Apple iPhone Duo First Foldable iPhone The Apple iPhone Duo introduces a completely new iPhone experience with a premium foldable design. The slimmer bezel enhances the overall display, ensuring an immersive viewing experience, while the vibrant colour options let you express your personal style. Crafted for Durability Built to last, the Galaxy S24 FE is protected by Corning® Gorilla® Glass Victus®+, covering both the front and back. This added durability ensures your device can withstand the rigours of daily use. Plus, the IP68 water and dust resistance rating gives you peace of mind in challenging environments. Effortless Photo Editing with Photo Assist The Galaxy S24 FE introduces Photo Assist, an AI-powered tool that makes editing photos easier than ever. Whether you want to resize, move, or remove unwanted objects, this feature transforms your ordinary photos into something extraordinary, with just a few taps. Creativity Unleashed with Sketch to Image With Sketch to Image, you can turn your creativity into reality. Powerful ProVisual Engine Camera The Galaxy S24 FE’s ProVisual Engine takes mobile photography to the next level. title: Apple AirPods 4 with Active Noise Cancellation
tagline: Active Noise Cancellation, Adaptive Audio, and Transparency mode
descriptionText: Active Noise Cancellation, Adaptive Audio, and Transparency mode Personalized Spatial Audio with dynamic head tracking Voice Isolation, Hey Siri, and Siri Interactions Up to 5 hours of listening time on a single charge (up to 4 hours with Active Noise Cancellation enabled) Up to 30 hours of listening time (up to 20 hours with Active Noise Cancellation enabled), using the case Wireless Charging Case (USB-C) with speaker for Find Me Dust, sweat, and water resistant Apple AirPods 4 with Active Noise Cancellation Redesigned for Comfort & Superior Sound The Apple AirPods 4 are reimagined for exceptional fit, stability, and all-day comfort. Designed with a compact form and advanced acoustic engineering, they deliver stunning audio clarity and deep, rich bass. Now featuring Active Noise Cancellation (ANC), Adaptive Audio, and Transparency Mode for the first time in this design, AirPods 4 ensure a truly immersive listening experience for every Sri Lankan user. Powered by the H2 Chip The powerful Apple H2 chip transforms how you hear and communicate. It provides intelligent sound tuning, reduces distortion, and delivers clearer calls with Voice Isolation. The Conversation Awareness feature automatically lowers volume and enhances nearby voices — keeping your interactions natural and hands-free. Personalized Spatial Audio with Dynamic Head Tracking Experience music in 3D with Personalized Spatial Audio. Dynamic head tracking adjusts sound placement as you move, creating a surround-sound effect that feels like you’re in the center of every song or movie scene — a perfect match for the entertainment lifestyle in Sri Lanka. Apple AirPods 4 with Active Noise Cancellation Built for Everyday Life Stay active with IP54 dust, sweat, and water resistance, perfect for workouts or outdoor adventures in Sri Lanka’s tropical climate. Whether you’re at the gym or commuting, AirPods 4 stay secure and protected. Long Battery Life & Smart Charging Apple AirPods 4 with Active Noise Cancellation Enjoy up to 5 hours of listening time on a single charge (or 4 hours with ANC). With the USB-C Wireless Charging Case, get up to 30 hours total playback. The case includes a built-in speaker for Find My and supports Apple Watch and Qi wireless chargers — making charging easy and flexible. Made for Convenience & Sustainability AirPods 4 come without a USB-C cable or power adapter, encouraging users to use existing accessories for eco-friendly charging. You can also purchase genuine Apple accessories if needed.

title: Apple AirPods 4
tagline: Personalized Spatial Audio with dynamic head tracking
descriptionText: Personalized Spatial Audio with dynamic head tracking Voice Isolation, Hey Siri, and Siri Interactions Up to 5 hours of listening time on a single charge Up to 30 hours total of listening time, using the case Charging Case (USB-C) Dust, sweat, and water resistant Apple AirPods 4 A Completely Transformed Audio Experience Step into a new era of sound with the Apple AirPods 4, designed to deliver immersive, theater-like audio for music, movies, and games. With Personalized Spatial Audio and dynamic head tracking, every sound feels alive — surrounding you in a 3D environment for a truly cinematic experience. Whether you’re relaxing at home or commuting through Sri Lanka’s busy streets, AirPods 4 bring sound closer than ever. Powered by the H2 Chip for Smarter Sound The advanced H2 chip transforms the way you listen. It enhances clarity, balances tones, and intelligently adapts to your surroundings. Whether you’re taking a call or enjoying a playlist, Voice Isolation ensures your voice remains clear — even in loud or windy environments. Plus, studio-quality recording lets you create high-fidelity voice notes and podcasts with ease. Active Noise Cancellation – Silence the World Experience true peace with Active Noise Cancellation (ANC). Powered by upgraded microphones and the H2 chip, AirPods 4 eliminate unwanted low-frequency noise — from airplane engines to Colombo traffic — letting you focus on your favorite tunes or conversations. Superior Acoustic Design for Richer Sound AirPods 4 use an Apple-designed low-distortion driver with a custom high dynamic range amplifier, producing crystal-clear highs and deep bass. Every beat, note, and rhythm feels richer and more detailed, giving you a concert-like experience wherever you are in Sri Lanka. Redesigned for Comfort & Stability Enjoy all-day comfort with a refined ergonomic design. The AirPods 4 fit securely, providing stability for workouts, travel, and long listening sessions without ear fatigue. Smarter, Smaller Charging Case The wireless charging case is over 10% smaller yet more powerful, featuring a built-in speaker for Find My alerts. It offers long battery life and quick top-ups for uninterrupted listening.

title: Xiaomi Redmi 14C 8GB RAM 256GB
descriptionText: Immersive 6.88″ display Refined and stylish design Powerful octa-core processor Massive 5160mAh (typ) battery Up to 120Hz high refresh rate 50MP AI dual camera Xiaomi Redmi 14C Rounded Design Aesthetic Glamour at Your Fingertips The Redmi 14C boasts a refined rounded design that evokes elegance and sophistication. Redmi 14C Helio G81-Ultra: Performance and Efficiency The MediaTek Helio G81-Ultra processor ensures smooth performance across all tasks. With its octa-core architecture, this chipset balances power and efficiency, reducing lag while enhancing battery life. Whether gaming, streaming, or multitasking, the Helio G81-Ultra delivers top-notch performance. A Device for the Modern User With its sleek design, powerful performance, and thoughtful features, the Redmi 14C is the perfect device for modern users who prioritize both aesthetics and functionality. From its eye-catching display to its cutting-edge camera system, every aspect of this phone is crafted to enhance the user experience.

title: Google Pixel 9 Pro Fold 16GB RAM 256GB
descriptionText: 16 GB RAM | 256 GB ROM 16.0 cm (6.3 inch) Display 48MP + 10.5MP + 10.8MP | 10MP Front Camera 4650 mAh Battery Google Tensor G4 Processor Google Pixel 9 Pro Fold Pixel 9 Pro Fold: An Epic Display of Google AI The Pixel 9 Pro Fold, powered by Google’s latest Gemini AI, is a marvel of modern technology. Engineered by Google, this device offers an unmatched combination of innovative features and powerful performance, setting a new standard for foldable smartphones. Stands Up to Slips and Spills Durability is at the heart of the Pixel 9 Pro Fold’s design. With a sturdy hinge and Corning Gorilla Glass Victus 2 on both the outer display and back, this phone is built to withstand life’s inevitable bumps and drops. Whether it’s a minor slip or a more serious fall, the Pixel 9 Pro Fold is designed to keep going strong. Hinge: Opens Smoothly, Stands Solidly The Pixel 9 Pro Fold’s hinge is engineered for smooth operation and reliable stability. Whether you’re using it lying flat or propping it up in various standing positions, the hinge holds firm, ensuring the device remains sturdy through every fold and unfold. Displays: Meet Your New Dream Screens The Pixel 9 Pro Fold features two stunning displays that redefine your viewing experience. The 20.32 cm (8-inch) Super Actua Flex inner display is 80% brighter than before, offering immersive entertainment, while the 16.002 cm (6.3-inch) Actua outer display makes daily tasks a breeze. Together, these screens deliver vibrant colors, sharp details, and smooth responsiveness. Google Tensor G4: The Power Behind AI on Pixel At the core of the Pixel 9 Pro Fold is the Google Tensor G4 chip, Google’s fastest and most powerful chip to date. This chip drives the AI capabilities that make the Pixel 9 Pro Fold exceptional, enabling innovative camera features, seamless multitasking, and intelligent assistance throughout your day. A Camera That Unfolds a World of Creativity The Pixel 9 Pro Fold’s flexible design and powerful triple rear camera system open up new possibilities for photography. With advanced AI, you can easily capture brilliant selfies, stunning group photos, and make custom edits that bring your creativity to life. The camera adapts to your needs, making every shot a masterpiece. Multitask Like a Pro with Split Screen Multitasking is a breeze with the Pixel 9 Pro Fold’s epic display. The Split Screen feature allows you to run multiple apps simultaneously, enhancing productivity and making it easier to manage tasks on the go. Whether you’re working, browsing, or enjoying media, the Pixel 9 Pro Fold keeps everything running smoothly. Tabletop Mode: Hands-Free Pics and More Tabletop mode is perfect for capturing hands-free photos or video calls. Simply prop up the Pixel 9 Pro Fold, and let the AI-powered camera do the rest. This feature makes it easier to capture perfect selfies, group shots, or even record videos without needing a tripod. The Pixel 9 Pro Fold adapts to your lifestyle, offering convenience and flexibility in every situation.

title: Apple iPhone 16 Pro Max 1TB
descriptionText: 6.7″ Super Retina XDR display Titanium with textured matte glass back Apple Intelligence A18 chip with 6-core GPU Dolby Vision up to 4K at 120 fps 48MP Fusion |12MP Ultra Wide Super-high-resolution photos Emergency SOS Up to 33 hours’ video playback Apple iPhone 16 Pro Max A Revolution in Design and Performance Titanium Brilliance: The Strength Behind the Beauty The iPhone 16 Pro Max introduces a Grade 5 titanium design, featuring a refined microblasted finish that not only enhances its aesthetic appeal but also its durability. Titanium is renowned for its exceptional strength-to-weight ratio, making the iPhone 16 Pro Max incredibly strong while remaining impressively light. Available in four stunning colors, including the new Desert Titanium, this phone is as much a fashion statement as it is a technological marvel. Advanced Thermal Management for Enhanced Performance Apple has reimagined the internal design of the iPhone 16 Pro Max, incorporating a 100% recycled aluminum thermal substructure. This innovation, combined with back glass optimizations, allows for better heat dissipation, leading to up to 20% better sustained performance compared to the iPhone 15 Pro Max. Whether you’re gaming or multitasking, the iPhone 16 Pro Max stays cooler and performs better for longer. Super Retina XDR Displays: Bigger, Brighter, Better The iPhone 16 Pro Max features new display technology that reduces border size, allowing for larger Super Retina XDR displays—6.9 inches on the Pro Max. These displays not only offer a more immersive viewing experience but also feel great in the hand, thanks to their sleek design and enhanced ergonomics. Apple Intelligence: A New Era of Personalization and Privacy With the iPhone 16 Pro Max, Apple introduces Apple Intelligence—a suite of AI-powered tools designed to make your smartphone experience more personal, private, and powerful. Apple Intelligence helps you write, focus, and communicate more effectively, while also enabling new creative possibilities like generating personal, fun images. Importantly, Apple Intelligence is built with privacy at its core, using on-device processing to keep your personal information secure. Private Cloud Compute: Power and Privacy Combined One of the standout features of Apple Intelligence is the Private Cloud Compute. This groundbreaking technology allows the iPhone 16 Pro Max to tap into larger, Apple-designed server-based models for handling complex tasks, all while maintaining your privacy. By integrating on-device processing with server-based models, Apple Intelligence offers unparalleled performance without compromising on security. Total Camera Control: Elevate Your Photography Game The iPhone 16 Pro Max introduces Camera Control, a new feature that allows you to take the perfect photo or video in record time. With a simple slide of your finger, you can adjust camera functions like exposure, depth of field, and digital zoom. This intuitive control makes it easier than ever to capture stunning images and videos, tailored to your exact specifications. Cinemasterful 4K 120 fps Dolby Vision: Professional Video in Your Pocket For video enthusiasts, the iPhone 16 Pro Max is a game-changer. With the new 48MP Fusion camera and the A18 Pro chip, you can now record in 4K 120 fps Dolby Vision—the highest resolution and frame rate combo ever offered on an iPhone. This feature not only allows for breathtaking video quality but also gives you greater control over playback speed, enabling cinematic effects like slow motion at 24 fps. Audio Mix: Perfect Your Soundtrack The iPhone 16 Pro Max’s advanced Audio Mix feature is powered by AI and Spatial Audio capture, allowing you to adjust the way voices sound in your videos. With options to decrease background noise or focus on the voices in frame, Audio Mix lets you create the perfect soundtrack for your videos, all with a few simple adjustments after capture. iPhone 16 Pro Max A18 Pro Chip: The Powerhouse Behind Apple Intelligence At the heart of the iPhone 16 Pro Max is the A18 Pro chip, which enables the advanced features of Apple Intelligence. This chip boasts a faster Neural Engine, an improved CPU and GPU, and a significant increase in memory bandwidth. These enhancements drive the phone’s best-ever graphics performance, making it perfect for AAA gaming and other demanding tasks. Extended Battery Life and Faster Charging: Power That Lasts Despite its powerful new features, the iPhone 16 Pro Max delivers up to four more hours of battery life than its predecessor. This is achieved through an optimized internal design that accommodates larger batteries, working in harmony with the A18 Pro chip for power-efficient performance. Additionally, the new MagSafe charger supports even faster wireless charging, allowing you to reach up to 50% charge in just 30 minutes with a 30W power adapter or higher. gsmarena Conclusion: The Future of Smartphones is Here The iPhone 16 Pro Max is more than just a smartphone; it’s a glimpse into the future of mobile technology. With its groundbreaking design, advanced AI capabilities, and unparalleled performance, the iPhone 16 Pro Max sets a new standard for what a phone can be. Whether you’re a tech enthusiast, a creative professional, or someone who simply wants the best, the iPhone 16 Pro Max offers something for everyone.

title: Jabra Elite 7 Pro Noise Cancelling Earbuds
descriptionText: Clear calls anywhere Adjustable Active Noise Cancellation Bluetooth® Multipoint Up to 8 hours of battery Ultra-compact design Jabra Elite 7 Pro Noise Cancelling Earbuds Selective hearing Immersion is great when you’re on a busy subway train, but what about when you need to hear what’s happening for a minute? Our clever HearThrough technology uses the built-in microphones to pick up the sounds around you and play them in your ears, so you can select the sounds that matter. When you need to order a coffee, or safely cross the road, just tap your earbud button to let the real world in, all without removing a bud. Control your surroundings From the subway to the front of the coffee shop line – you need different levels of immersion or awareness throughout the day. With our adjustable ANC and HearThrough technology, you’re in complete control of how you hear (or don’t hear) your surroundings. When you’ve decided how much of the outside world you feel like letting in today, choose from one of our five expertly optimized levels of ANC or HearThrough in the Sound+ app, for the right sound, every time. NEXT-GENERATION SOUND Meet your soul mates Your music is about to get a serious upgrade, with Elite 7 Pro. We’ve redefined what’s possible in a tiny true wireless earbud, completely re-engineering the 6mm custom speakers, refining and optimizing their speaker performance, and meticulously positioning the internal components to eliminate sound distortion. At the same time, our intelligent algorithms constantly adjust and optimize sound frequencies, for rich, powerful sound that’ll send shivers down your spine. But it’s not just the sound that’s powerful. These clever little buds can automatically adjust your sound to your unique hearing profile, for music like you’ve never heard it before, while a customizable equalizer lets you further fine-tune your sound to your liking. RE-ENGINEERED BATTERY LIFE 8 hours. Non-stop Elite 7 Pro features a re-engineered battery and our advanced efficiency technology, giving you up to 8 hours in the buds and up to 30 hours with the case. And if you do get caught out, a speedy 5-minute fast charge gets you up to an hour of power.

title: SoundPEAT RunFree Lite – Bluetooth Air Conduction Sport Headphones
descriptionText: Air Conduction Tech Open-Ear Secure& 0.99oz Lightweight 2mm Large Driver& Bass Enhancement Tech 3 Stable Multipoint Connection 17 Hours of Music & Talk SoundPEAT RunFree Lite – Bluetooth Air Conduction Sport Headphones Safety and Privacy SOUNDPEATS RunFree Lite are air-conduction headphones that are specifically designed for sports. The open-ear design allows you to stay aware of your surroundings while still enjoying your music, providing ultimate safety compared to traditional in-ear or over-ear sports headphones. The headphones also feature special directional sound transmission technology to minimize sound leakage, ensuring your privacy is respected. High-Quality Sound with Enhanced Bass Equipped with a 16.2mm driver and patented bass enhancement technology, RunFree Lite sports headphones deliver a powerful, immersive audio experience. With a 17-hour battery life, you can stay motivated and entertained throughout your workout. Bud-Free Comfort Unlike traditional wireless earphones, SOUNDPEATS RunFree Lite Open Ear Headphones utilize air conduction technology to provide a comfortable and painless listening experience. You won’t have to worry about hot ears, even during the hottest of runs. With a weight of only 28 g, these headphones are designed for all-day comfort. Advanced BT 5.3 and Multipoint Connection RunFree Lite Bluetooth 5.3 headphones provides a faster, more stable connection with lower power consumption. With Multi-Point Connection, you can pair with 2 Bluetooth devices simultaneously, and easily switch between two paired devices to answer coming calls while watching movies on PC with a simple click on the headphones. Sweatproof and Secure Fit The neckband of the RunFree Lite sports earphones is made of skin-friendly liquid silicone, ensuring a secure fit for any sport. The headphones are also IPX4 waterproof, resisting light rain and sweat, making them suitable for activities like jogging, running, driving, cycling, and hiking.

descriptionText: Google’s pro-level camera system. Titan M2 helps to keep you and your info safe. title: Bose QuietComfort® Earbuds
descriptionText: World-Class Noise Cancelling Quiet Mode & Aware Mode High-Fidelity Audio Secure & Comfortable Simple Touch Controls Clear Calls Sweat & Weather Resistant Up to 6 Hours 1-year Warranty Bose QuietComfort® Earbuds RULE THE QUIET™ Better sound begins with better silence. That’s why we engineered QuietComfort® Earbuds with world-class noise cancelling and high-fidelity audio, plus StayHear™ Max tips for extra comfort. Because when you eliminate distractions, your music takes centerstage, and so does your passion. Roller skating, street art, woodworking — and every other thing that makes you, you. It’s an experience you won’t find in any other wireless earbud. Decades of research. Instant silence. Our soft, silicone eartips passively block some noise. But the true quiet comes from our Acoustic Noise Cancelling™ technology. Microphones hidden in the earbuds monitor environmental sounds and then produce the opposite signal to cancel that noise. It’s tech we’ve spent decades researching. But you feel the benefit in a fraction of a second. From Quiet to Aware. With just a double tap. In Quiet Mode, our Acoustic Noise Cancelling™ technology mutes the world around you, so you can better hear — and feel — every detail of your music. But there are circumstances when you need to be able to hear your surroundings. You can quickly switch to Aware Mode with a simple double tap of the left earbud. QuietComfort® Earbuds now feature Aware Mode with ActiveSense™ technology, which allows you to hear your music and your surroundings at the same time. And if those surroundings get too loud, ActiveSense™ automatically adjusts the amount of noise cancellation to turn the sounds around you down to a more comfortable level. The result is hearing everything you need to at a pleasant and balanced volume You’ll love what you hear QuietComfort® Earbuds’ breakthrough innovations and exclusive acoustic architecture let you hear everything you love in high-fidelity audio — no matter how loud or soft you play it. And that’s no small thing. On most earbuds, bass disappears when you lower the volume, leaving your music sounding tinny and small. We solved this with our volume-optimized Active EQ. It boosts highs and lows for consistent balance no matter how loud or soft you listen. Comfort. That stays put. Every surface that touches your ear is made of soft silicone — not hard plastic. And when you move, StayHear™ Max tips (three sizes included) keep your earbuds in place. An umbrella shaped nozzle spreads pressure evenly across your ear for comfort, stability, and passive noise blocking. All while an extended fin tucks into the ridge of your ear for an even more secure fit. Tap, touch, swipe controls. Seamless capacitive gestures make it easy to control these advanced earbuds. Change the volume, flip between noise cancelling and Aware Mode, and answer calls. All with simple swipes and taps. When you’re done listening, just pop them out. QuietComfort Earbuds sense the movement and pause your music automatically. Clearer conversations. Wherever you have them. Tiny mics, hidden in the right earbud, work together to reject noise and ensure you always sound clear — whether you’re taking calls from a busy home or on the go outside. The mics focus on the sound of your voice, while filtering out most of the sounds and wind around you. Play, store, charge — repeat. Listen for up to 6 hours on a single charge. Then when you’re done, pop them in the case for an additional 2 full charges. And when it’s time, recharge the case via the included USB-C or any Qi-certified wireless charging mat (not included).

The integration of the A15 chip with iOS 15 ensures a seamless experience with better app performance and new features that enhance everyday productivity. MagSafe and Accessories Support The iPhone 13 is compatible with MagSafe accessories, making charging and accessory attachment easy and efficient. MagSafe accessories allow users to snap on cases, chargers, and wallets magnetically, adding convenience and a layer of personalization to the iPhone 13 experience.

title: Apple iPhone 11 128GB
tagline: 6.1″ Liquid Retina IPS LCD capacitive touchscreen
descriptionText: 6.1″ Liquid Retina IPS LCD capacitive touchscreen 12 MP Dual Primary Camera 12 MP Selfie Camera Non-removable Li-Ion 3110 mAh Battery Apple iPhone 11 128GB Just the right amount of everything. A new dual‑camera system captures more of what you see and love. The fastest chip ever in a smartphone and all‑day battery life let you do more and charge less. And the highest‑quality video in a smartphone, so your memories look better than ever. All‑new dual‑camera system. Take your photos from wide to ultra-wide. A redesigned interface uses the new Ultra-Wide camera to show you what’s happening outside the frame — and lets you capture it. Shoot and edit videos as easily as you do photos. It’s the world’s most popular camera, now with a whole new perspective. 12MP Ultra Wide Capturing four times more scene, it’s great for landscapes, travel, groups, large interiors, and action shots. Kick your video up a notch. Over a smidge. Or down a hair. Shoot and edit the highest-quality video in a smartphone. iPhone 11 shoots beautifully sharp 4K video at 60 fps across all its cameras. The Ultra-Wide camera captures four times more scene, so it’s perfect for action shots like your dog catching a frisbee. If you’re recording a performance — say, your kid’s piano recital — when you zoom in, the audio zooms too. And now you can edit videos as easily as you do photos. “OK, everyone, scooch out a bit.” New Ultra Wide camera. Go big — the new Ultra-Wide camera captures four times more scene. Think breathtaking landscapes that go on forever. Capturing the entire stage and crowd at a music festival. And vacation shots that show the whole family — including the views you travelled 11,000 miles for. Not enough light? No problem. Introducing Night mode. Shooting in low light doesn’t have to be a shot in the dark. Night mode is a new feature that turns on automatically for low‑light photos like you’ve never seen. There’s no need for flash, colours are more natural, and photos are brighter. Portrait-perfect. Take portraits to new places. With new kinds of portraits and more lighting controls, the dual cameras in iPhone 11 work together to create stunning images. And Portrait mode now works with everything you love to shoot — that includes your best friends, two‑legged or four. The High-Key Light Mono effect in iOS 13 transforms your portraits into beautiful, studio‑style monochromes. And Portrait Lighting Control lets you create the look you want by changing the intensity of light on your subjects. Smart HDR. The easiest form of flattery. Next‑generation Smart HDR. Thanks to machine learning, Smart HDR is more intelligent than ever. It recognizes people and treats them differently from the rest of the shot. So faces have beautiful highlights, shadows, and natural‑looking skin tones. And that stunning sunset in the background still looks gorgeous. Go from pics to video faster than a speeding toddler. Start shooting video instantly with QuickTake. Take a video simply by holding the shutter while in photo mode. Then swipe to the right to continue recording. If you’re shooting outdoors, A13 Bionic can use machine learning to automatically track a moving subject. Slo‑mo your selfie. Introducing the slofie. Everything looks cooler at 120 fps, even if you’re just saying cheese, waving hi, or tossing your hair in the breeze. And now you can add more of everything to your selfies thanks to the new 12MP TrueDepth camera. Just turn your iPhone to landscape and the camera automatically zooms out to fit more in. Designed to take a spill and a splash The toughest glass in a smartphone. Front glass and back glass are strengthened through a dual ion‑exchange process. Water-resistant to twice the depth. iPhone 11 is water-resistant up to 2 meters for up to 30 minutes — double the depth of iPhone XR.1Roses are red, violets are violet. All in a day’s charge. All-day battery life. Hardware and software work together to get the most out of your battery. And thanks to fast‑charge capability, you can recharge in less time. A chip that’s all Pro. Both iPhone 11 and iPhone 11 Pro have the fastest chip ever in a smartphone. A13 Bionic is so powerful, everything you do is fast and fluid. It also works in the most power‑efficient way possible, so your battery lasts longer. In fact, A13 Bionic is so advanced, it’s years ahead of the pack.

title: Bose 700 Noise Cancelling Wireless Headphones
descriptionText: Bose AR Audio-Only Augmented Reality One-Touch Access to Voice Assistants Built-In Google Assistant & Amazon Alexa Active EQ Sound Management Bose 700 Noise Cancelling Wireless Headphones Enjoy seamless integration into your mobile lifestyle with the luxe silver Bose Headphones 700 noise-canceling Bluetooth headphones. Utilize the built-in Google Assistant and Amazon Alexa combined with one-touch access to voice assistants for comprehensive, convenient, hands-free control of your smartphone functions, all while leaving your phone in your pocket. Through intuitive taps and gestures on the right earcup’s touch surface, you can control functions such as answering/declining calls, adjusting volume, skipping tracks, and playing/pausing audio. Plus, the innovative Bose AR audio-only augmented reality function fluidly merges digital experiences with the physical world around you to enhance the way you travel, exercise, and more. Thanks to the adaptive 4-microphone system, your voice will be picked up with clarity and consistency regardless of your location, so you won’t have to waste time repeating voice commands or conversations with friends. 11 levels of noise cancellation and a special Conversation Mode allow you to decide exactly how much ambient sound you want to hear, whether you’re working indoors at the office, flying to a remote destination, or walking through the city. Active EQ sound management manipulates the sonic signature of the headphones to keep you immersed in your content at any listening volume. The sleek over-ear design features a lightweight, padded, stainless-steel headband and angled, rotating earcups, ensuring all-day comfort. With 20 hours of wireless battery life, you’re likely to wear them from morning until night. Bose 700 Adaptive 4-microphone system picks up and isolates your voice while cancelling the noise around you Optimized for Google Assistant and Amazon Alexa; press a button on the right earcup to activate your chosen voice assistant. Manage tracks, volume, and phone calls with intuitive touch controls on the right earcup. Personalize the amount of ambient noise you wish to hear with 11 levels of noise cancellation plus Conversation Mode. Bose 700 For quick interruptions, press a button for Conversation Mode to pause the music and let surrounding noise in Combining the power of wearable audio products, mobile devices, and integrated apps, Bose AR unlocks the potential to experience fundamentally new ways to travel, exercise, learn, play, and more by augmenting your world with content for your ears instead of your eyes. Enjoy an immersive listening experience at any volume with signature active EQ and plentiful bass response; whether you’re listening at low volumes or really want to turn it up, your music sounds just as it should. Proprietary TriPort acoustic headphone structure utilizes external ports to vent the earcups and effectively enlarge the acoustic volume without increasing the size of the earcup, giving you better audio and active noise reduction from a smaller, lighter, more comfortable headphone. Stainless-steel headband with ultra-soft foam underside. Comfortable, angled earcups made from synthetic protein leather.
